assumptions.label: Exit multiple (X), anchored
assumptions.basis: anchored: the lowest of today's multiple 36.15x, the FY2017 to FY2026 median EV/FCF 25.85x (range 15.61x to 38.47x) and 17.33x, the multiple whose implied perpetual growth at your 10% required return is 4%. Each year's EV is its last close on or before its fiscal year end times its diluted weighted-average shares on the closes' split basis, less its net cash. A past 10-K's cover count never binds, while today's multiple uses the latest one. FY2026's diluted average is 1.29% above it, so the years' multiples read high against today's.

Starts FY2003 to FY2020, from SEC's companyfacts archive of 2026-11-24 (sha256 72bc1c52670fe57a3d701f13cbab55763c122388b314d1eaca921bb18ddfbacd). Revenue's base rate is shown beside it and is never an input. Not among the 430: 38 that ended early (the filer stopped filing before year 5), 6 with no year-5 figure, 95 whose two ends use different capex or cash flow concepts, 1 whose cash flow and capex at one end cover different periods and 45 that started at zero or negative free cash flow. 37 of the 430 ended at or below zero and count as -100%

reasons.text: The base value V is USD 165.86 per share. The value test holds up to V ÷ your margin of safety 1.25 = USD 132.68.
The bear value B is USD 111.73 per share. The bear-loss test holds up to B ÷ (1 − your 25% bear-loss limit) = USD 148.97.
The hurdle price H is USD 132.68, the lower of the two. The price, USD 342.37, is above H × (1 + your 10% near band) = USD 145.95.
Growth one point in the base and bear cases together: higher, H USD 138.36; lower, H USD 127.21. No tested move changes the stance.
The share change one point in both cases: higher, H USD 127.06; lower, H USD 138.65. No tested move changes the stance.
Your required return one point: higher, H USD 127.54; lower, H USD 138.11. No tested move changes the stance.
The exit multiple 1x in both cases: higher, H USD 138.33; lower, H USD 127.04. No tested move changes the stance.
